properties.name: Calangute North Swimming Zone
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard-supervised designated swim area, marked in reality by red-and-yellow flags, near the northern stretch of the beach.

properties.name: Calangute South Swimming Zone
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard-supervised designated swim area, marked in reality by red-and-yellow flags, near the southern stretch of the beach.

properties.name: Calangute North-Central Restricted Zone (Water Sports Channel)
properties.description: Approximate no-swim zone around the water sports boat channel (jet skis, parasailing, banana boats), marked in reality by black-and-white flags. Fast boat traffic makes this stretch dangerous for swimmers.

properties.name: Calangute South-Central Restricted Zone (Water Sports Channel)
properties.description: Approximate no-swim zone around a second water sports boat channel, marked in reality by black-and-white flags. Fast boat traffic makes this stretch dangerous for swimmers.
